author: Priyanka Patel
title: AI Compass: Inclusive Tech & Workshop Demo
text:
AI-Powered Rehabilitation: Specialists to Explore cutting-Edge Assistance Systems
A new training event on september 19, 2025, will focus on the integration of artificial intelligence into professional rehabilitation, offering specialists hands-on experience with the latest AI-assisted technologies. The event, running from 9:00 CEST to 1:00 p.m. CEST, will showcase systems developed by the Ki-compass project Inclusive, with a focus on practical application adn future growth.
Revolutionizing Professional Participation with AI
The field of professional participation and rehabilitation is poised for significant advancement thanks to the rapid development of AI. This event provides a crucial prospect for specialists to upskill and explore the potential of these new tools. Employees of the Ki-compass project Inclusive will introduce participants to between three and six AI-based assistance systems, allowing for direct, on-site testing.
A subsequent workshop will be dedicated to brainstorming future applications of these systems. Participants will collaboratively discuss the opportunities, challenges, and necessary framework conditions for successful implementation, with a focus on translating their experiences to individual environments and specific support needs.
Ki-compass Inclusive: A Portfolio of AI Solutions
Ki-compass Including is actively developing a comprehensive portfolio of AI-based demo technologies and informational resources specifically tailored for professional rehabilitation. According to a company release, these technologies range from mobile apps and PC applications to traditional written handouts. Notably, many of these technologies are nearing market maturity and will be available for purchase following the demonstrations.
“This event is about more than just showcasing technology,” stated a senior official.”It’s about empowering professionals to understand how AI can truly transform the lives of those they serve.”
Registration Details
Those interested in participating must register by September 5, 2025. The event promises to be a pivotal moment in the evolution of rehabilitation practices, offering a glimpse into a future where AI plays a central role in fostering greater professional participation and independence.
